findings.passage: AG Kaul said the ruling would "require a massive overhaul of Wisconsin’s voter registration system and the creation of new verification requirements not otherwise provided for by statute."
findings.note: Quoted by Townhall from the Attorney General's request to pause a court order that told the state elections agency to check voter rolls against driver-record data for non-citizens. Date is the article date.

findings.motion: Wisconsin Department of Justice appeal, led by the Attorney General, of the Waukesha County order on checking voter rolls for non-citizens
findings.note: The appeal filing states: "The circuit court’s decision and order drastically alters voter registration and elections in Wisconsin, violates state law, and threatens voting rights," and "The court issued this sweeping relief despite no evidence of injury to Respondents: they speculated about the risk of vote dilution by illegal voters, but provided no evidence that a noncitizen had voted or registered to vote in Wisconsin." Report text says current law has registrants affirm citizenship without giving proof.

findings.passage: Ghost guns shouldn't be exempted from rules that apply to other firearms. When a background check is required to buy a firearm, it should be required to buy a ghost gun as well,
findings.note: Statement in a Wisconsin Department of Justice release in his name: he joined 24 attorneys general in a Supreme Court brief urging the court to uphold the federal ghost gun rule (Garland v. VanDerStok).

findings.passage: Ghost guns make our communities less safe. The ghost gun loophole makes it easier for people who are prohibited from possessing a firearm to get one, and it can make it more difficult to solve crimes,
findings.note: Statement in a Wisconsin Department of Justice release in his name: he joined 21 other attorneys general in a comment urging the federal agency to finalize its ghost gun rule.

findings.passage: The legislation that was proposed in the last session, that's included in the governor's budget, would close those loopholes
findings.note: Quoted by CBS58 (the fetch tool returned the sentence with a break after 'loopholes'; the next fragment reads 'and make sure that everybody who's getting a firearm has to go through the same background check process'). He calls for background checks on all gun transfers.

findings.passage: If this budget isn't the right time, when is the right time?
findings.note: Quoted by WPR at an event with lawmakers urging the budget measures on universal background checks and a red flag law.

findings.passage: There's nothing that's going to stop all mass shootings.
findings.note: Quoted by WPR after the Molson Coors shooting; the same article quotes him next: 'But there are steps than can make our communities safer and reduce the likelihood that these will happen.' He says he agrees with the governor and a state representative on gun safety steps.

findings.passage: There has not been a legislative hearing on these topics in years,
findings.note: Quoted by WPR in a year-end interview about gun-safety legislation in Wisconsin; the same piece has him discussing making safe gun storage more accessible.
